meta.decoder: media_player.audio_decoder (decoder_1, wired to matrix source 2, pre_gain_pct 25) with companion decoder_1_companion
findings: a parked group (zone_17 leading zone_18) has hardware amplifiers off (_attr_state = 'off') and decoder_1 in 'off', yet zone_17.state reports 'idle' (or 'paused') in Home Assistant so Music Assistant does not dissolve the parked sync group

because DecoderPool.claim() and _environment_owners() checked the Home Assistant state machine (hass.states.get(owner).state) and only treated 'off' and 'unavailable' as inactive, zone_17's 'idle' state made DecoderPool treat decoder_1 as actively held and refuse zone_36 (badkamer) with 'All audio matrix inputs are currently in use by other rooms!'

when decoder_1 is idle/off and its owner is parked ('idle' or 'paused' in HA while the amplifier is off), DecoderPool.claim() must reassign decoder_1 to the new requester without emitting redundant OFF bus frames for the already-off parked rooms, and ZoneGroupLayer._reconcile_pool_loss() must clear _parked and _active_decoder on the displaced rooms so they transition cleanly from 'idle' to 'off'
